About ChefOnCall

Our story, our mission, our passion for food.

We Connect Passion with the Kitchen

ChefOnCall was founded in 2020 with a simple belief: every meal is an opportunity to create a lasting memory. We started as a small team of food enthusiasts in Chennai who wanted to make professional cooking accessible to everyone.

Today, we are India's fastest growing chef rental platform, connecting over 500 professional chefs with 10,000+ happy households across Tamil Nadu.

🎯

Our Mission

To democratize access to professional culinary expertise, making restaurant-quality food accessible to every home, for every occasion.

💫

Our Vision

A future where every family celebration, business dinner, or simple weekday meal can be elevated by the skills of a professional chef.
